title: Ron Johnson sees his lost dog's fate in a crystal

tellings.quote: disappeared in 1972 or something like this. He never knew what happened to his dog and he's watching the crystal the the dog's life and he saw the neighbor came, shot the dog, threw it in the back of a pickup and took it to the dump and threw it in the dump.

plain: A man named Ron Johnson, whose dog vanished around 1972, is said to have watched the dog's life play out inside a crystal years later and to have seen what happened: a neighbor came, shot the dog, threw it in the back of a pickup truck and dumped it at the dump. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells Michels this as something Johnson told him. If true, it would mean a crystal could show a person scenes from the past.
